subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the shear wall between Sheet S-301 and Structural

messages.text: The shear wall reinforcement shown in Sheet S-301 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Structural Detail 3/S502. We need an urgent response on this; please treat it as time-sensitive. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification. Please respond within two business days ahead of the scheduled pour.

Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Structural Detail 3/S502; Sheet S-301 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification.
